He was an incredible man and one of the most caring doctors I have ever known. When Dr Dharma later took over, he too was excellent and showed the same compassion and professionalism.

Sadly, I cannot say the same for the surgery as it stands today. The new doctors and reception staff are a world apart from the standard this practice was once known for. I recently spent over an hour on hold trying to book an appointment for my dad, who has just had a stroke and needed follow up appointments. That is unacceptable.

Dr Gupta in particular has been the most unhelpful and dismissive doctor I have ever come across, showing no genuine care or support. I truly feel sorry for the patients who have joined in more recent years and never experienced the quality of service that Leigh Surgery once delivered.

This practice should take inspiration from the footsteps of the late Dr George and Dr Dharma, who set the bar high for what patient care should look like.
